class.name: HTTPServer
class.brief_description: A node that hosts an HTTP server.
class.description: [b]Note:[/b] This class is a placeholder. It exposes the configuration surface of an HTTP server, but does not open a listening socket yet, so [method start] never serves requests. This class lives in the [code]foundry.http.server[/code] namespace, so it is reached either by its fully qualified name [code skip-lint]foundry.http.server.HTTPServer[/code] or, after [code]import foundry.http.server[/code], by the bare name [code]HTTPServer[/code]. Without that import the bare name does not resolve.

method.name: start
method.description: Starts the server on [member port] and returns [code]true[/code] on success. [b]Note:[/b] No socket is opened yet, so this always returns [code]true[/code].

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops the server. Does nothing if the server is not running.

members.member: The TCP port the server listens on. Must be between [code]0[/code] and [code]65535[/code]; values outside that range are rejected and leave the property unchanged.
